array.string: cd "$HOME" || exit 1 export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" launchctl setenv PATH "$PATH" apply_env() { while IFS='=' read -r key value; do case "$key" in export\ *) key="${key#export }" case "$value" in \'*\') value="${value#\'}"; value="${value%\'}" ;; \"*\") value="${value#\"}"; value="${value%\"}" ;; esac if [ -n "$key" ]; then launchctl setenv "$key" "$value"; fi ;; esac done } # fnox secrets: cwd must be $HOME (or any dir under it) so fnox finds ~/fnox.toml FNOX="$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/fnox/latest/fnox" if [ -x "$FNOX" ]; then "$FNOX" export --format shell 2>/dev/null | apply_env else echo "MISSING fnox: $FNOX" fi # mise global env (~/.config/mise/env.yaml), cwd independent MISE=/opt/homebrew/bin/mise if [ -x "$MISE" ]; then "$MISE" env --shell bash 2>/dev/null | apply_env else echo "MISSING mise: $MISE" fi echo "fnox-env: done $(date)"
